summary: The alignment loop reuses existing catalogue mechanisms and gives them explicit directionality around the Companion App.

items.text: Provide the human-facing surface whose freshness and write-back paths the alignment contract governs.
Extend the existing specification meta-loop from spec-versus-code to companion-versus-artifact and human-intent-versus-durable-system reconciliation.
Use fingerprints, source versions, review timestamps and explicit state in visible companion files.
Write architectural rationale into the established searchable decision store.
Run change-triggered alignment stages as named, versioned pipeline roles.
Use scheduled sweeps to detect slow or cross-cutting drift that no individual change trigger sees.
Reuse the layered wiki maintenance and learnings stages when the companion takes wiki form.
